scope: Repair three proven false-PASS paths without changing the candidate or historical evidence archive.
implementation_choice: Version four corrected script files outside the immutable archive; replay verifies archive manifest and replacement hashes before applying them only inside its temporary extraction. Existing reports remain historical.

checks.contrast-invalid: Contrast ratio 1 must produce FAIL and nonzero exit.
checks.svg-valid: Correct master, black and white variants pass.
checks.svg-invalid-white: White variant rendered black must be rejected.
checks.pptx-valid-boundary: The same validator accepts the native fixture and explicitly rejects raster for missing native text; missing output directory is handled.
checks.pptx-broken-validator: A validator that raises RuntimeError must not make the probe pass.
checks.pptx-negative-operational-error: A validator which works for native but crashes for raster must not make the probe pass.

integration_limits: physical print and Office UI NOT_RUN
evaluation_kind: development regression controls, not blinded or causal
